phases.title: Foundations & the cascade
phases.blurb: Selectors, specificity, inheritance, custom properties. The rules that decide which declaration actually wins.

phases.title: Box model, sizing & units
phases.blurb: Every box has content, padding, border, margin. Learn to control space on purpose instead of nudging numbers.

phases.title: Typography
phases.blurb: Type is most of the page. Scales, line length, rhythm, web fonts, and text that survives real content.

phases.title: Color & backgrounds
phases.blurb: Color systems, modern color spaces, gradients, images, contrast that passes an audit.

phases.title: Borders, shadows & shapes
phases.blurb: Edges, depth, radius, outlines, and drawing without images.

phases.title: Display, flow & positioning
phases.blurb: Block vs inline, normal flow, floats, positioning, stacking contexts, z-index that behaves.

phases.title: Flexbox
phases.blurb: One-dimensional layout, properly understood: main axis, cross axis, growth, shrink, basis.

phases.title: Grid
phases.blurb: Two-dimensional layout: tracks, lines, areas, auto-placement, subgrid, and intrinsic sizing.

phases.title: Responsive & adaptive
phases.blurb: Fluid type, media queries, container queries, and layouts that hold from 320px to ultrawide.

phases.title: Transitions, transforms & animation
phases.blurb: Motion with intent: state transitions, keyframes, performance, reduced-motion.

phases.title: Component patterns
phases.blurb: The components every job asks for: buttons, forms, navs, modals, tables, cards, toasts.

phases.title: Architecture, systems & a11y
phases.blurb: Scaling CSS past one file: tokens, themes, methodologies, accessibility, performance, and CSS-in-React options.

phases.title: Capstones
phases.blurb: Whole products from a blank file, unassisted, to a deadline.

challenges.issueTitle: [001] Render your first challenge component and stylesheet
challenges.body:
**Phase 1 — Foundations & the cascade** · difficulty `intro` · challenge 1 of 500

Scaffold challenge 001 and prove the wiring works end to end: a component, its own stylesheet, and a visible style change on screen.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] src/challenges/001-hello-stylesheet/ contains index.tsx and styles.css
- [ ] index.tsx imports './styles.css' and default-exports a component
- [ ] At least three declarations change something visible (color, background, padding)
- [ ] The challenge appears in the sidebar and renders at #/c/001-hello-stylesheet

### In play

`import` `color` `background-color` `padding`

### Doing this one

```bash
gh issue develop 1 --checkout        # or: git switch -c challenge/001-hello-stylesheet
cd frontend && pnpm new 1            # scaffolds src/challenges/001-hello-stylesheet/
pnpm dev                                # opens at #/c/001-hello-stylesheet
```

When it works: `pnpm lint && pnpm build`, push, open a PR that says `Closes #<this issue>`, fill in the PR template, and get it reviewed against [`docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md`](https://github.com/willshepp28/learn-css-via-react/blob/main/docs/REVIEW-CHECKLIST.md).
